'''TC-326''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Anakin_choke_Poggle.png|thumb|left|180px|TC-326 watches as Skywalker "interrogates" Poggle in his holding cell]]
{{Quote|Your feeble Jedi mind tricks do not work on Geonosians. The other Jedi already learned this.|TC-326 translating [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] ability to resist mind tricks|<ref name="Brain Invaders">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>}}
TC-326 was first seen walking by a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Shortly after the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], he aided in translation during the debriefing of [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. He later witnessed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] physically strike Poggle and [[Force power/Legends|Force]]-[[Telekinesis/Legends|choke]] him until he surrendered and gave the information Skywalker sought.

==Characteristics==
TC-326 had gray plating with yellow stripes on its head and arms and the symbol of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] on its chest.

==Behind the scenes==
TC-326 was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|series]], the same actor who provided the voice for Obi-Wan Kenobi.
